content:
“Keep it clean and it lasts longer!”

**White Knight** is an Intelligence-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Armor becomes less prone to breaking and is less costly to repair.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Your armor breaks 60% slower and is cheaper to repair. | 0038AB86 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your armor breaks 40% slower and is cheaper to repair. | 0038AB85 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your armor breaks 20% slower and is cheaper to repair. | 0038AB84 | 

- Update 60, moved the perk from Agility to Intelligence.
- Prior to patch 5, the condition loss bonuses provided by each rank of the White Knight perk was 30%/60%/90%. Afterwards, they were reduced to 20%/40%/60% and the repair bonuses have also been reduced, to match the Power Patcher perk.

Other perks that increase durability include:

- Gunsmith - ranged weapons
- Licensed Plumber - pipe weapons
- Makeshift Warrior - melee weapons
- Power Patcher - power armor
- Stable Tools - power tools
